rationale: Legacy shadow declarations require package-by-package control-flow review; new or moved declarations are prohibited by the exact ratchet. Re-reviewed 2026-09-12 after three weeks without CI (2026-08-21 to 2026-09-12): the shadow sites that entered in that window are err/ctx/tx re-declarations inside their own if/for blocks, the same shape as the 2026-07-20 set; each is frozen at its exact location and burned down per package.

Capitalised or punctuated error strings entered while CI was offline; every one is client-visible text that tests assert on, so they are corrected per package with their tests rather than rewritten blind.
Remaining Staticcheck diagnostics are style and modernization suggestions scheduled for bounded package-level cleanups; re-reviewed 2026-09-12 with the sites that entered while CI was offline.

Legacy if/switch shape suggestions are behavior-neutral style debt that will be reduced during focused package passes; re-reviewed 2026-09-12 with the sites that entered while CI was offline (mapKey sites are test fixtures with whitespace-bearing keys, offBy1 sites were read and are bounds-safe).
These append results intentionally flow into a different owner or returned value and need domain review before a change; re-reviewed 2026-09-12 with the sites that entered while CI was offline.

Legacy feature scaffolding needs domain-owner confirmation before deletion or wiring; no new or relocated dead code is accepted beyond the exact set frozen here. Re-reviewed 2026-09-12 with the symbols that entered while CI was offline.
